analysis:
This PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md (date bump, a heartbeat/health-file paragraph near line 3528, and the release-computed cluster runtime approval text around lines 5230-5284). No executable code, keys, endpoints or authorization logic changed, so there is no direct security regression.

Checked the visible head-side excerpts (lines 4491-5332) against the retained threat model.
- The excerpt covers GPT-OSS/MiMo/Qwen batch and tensor-parallel notes, media ingress, and cluster runtime facts. It describes TB-007 inference-engine behavior and cluster pair-serving grants. It does not weaken the plaintext, attestation, App Attest (TB-011) or prefix-cache (T-041) controls.
- The runtime-facts text says a coordinator forms a session only if the native start matches the approval each member installed. It also says a coordinator holds pair members without a grant to single-Mac requirements. The docs match the existing grant-gating posture and make no claim that bypasses it.
- The claim that releases now compute and register `cluster_runtime` digests from the final app is a documentation description of a release lane. I could not verify it from the supplied evidence. Whether the release pipeline's registration path (A-005 release API key, A-011 hash registry) enforces authorization is outside this diff.
- The new heartbeat-file paragraph (per-part `part-health.json` vs `service-health.json`, PID check in the supervisor's liveness guard) is only visible in the patch excerpt, which is truncated. It describes an availability/liveness mechanism, with no visible trust-boundary change. Any file permissions or PID-spoofing implications in the underlying code are not evidenced here.
- The numbered patch hunks near 5250-5284 (parity qualifications, public model declaration) are partially visible. They are descriptive of existing policy, not a new control.

Remaining questions for integration are the unseen implementation files (ClusterRuntimeApprovalFacts+Release.swift, ClusterServiceAgent health paths, release-lane registration). They are not part of this docs-only change.
